story.title: Adventuring with Jhon and Ellina
paragraphs_en: Once upon a time there was a boy named Jhon who lived with his parents & twin sister Ellina. One day they went on a biking holiday to a flower valley, they were to camp near the lake for a week.

"Oh! look up at the pretty butterflies fluttering in the sky", said Ellina. Jhon looked up and said, "they are very pretty, but let us set up our camp first before it gets dark". So they both started setting their camps. Jhon started to put the pegs and Ellina started to unpack their stuff. Before dark it was all done.
By the time it was night it was cold so they had hot cocoa and soup for dinner, and they went to bed. Middle of the night, suddenly they heard some strange sound.

They strained their ears & realized it was men talking to each other. One of them said, "Are the stolen antiques safe"? "Yes, very safe indeed", replied another voice. Jhon heard all this and was now feeling scared. He woke up Ellina and told her all that he had heard. She said we should go tomorrow and investigate but let us sleep today.

In the morning they woke up early and went for a bath in the river. The water was icy cold. Shivering from their bath they, sat down for breakfast. They discussed the events of the last night & decided that they will go check the ruined castle, as that was the only place to hide in the vast wilderness.

So they trekked up to the ruined castle which sat atop a mountain. When they entered the castle, they were shocked to see many valuable antique pieces packed in a sac hidden from the plain view. They started wandering around separately to explore the place. Suddenly Ellina heard sounds of scuffle. Anxious & scared, she behind a pillar to see what was happening. The men had returned and seeing Jhon wandering in their safe zone had kidnapped him. Ellina quietly witnessed how they gagged & took her brother to their make-shift cottage nearby.

They took him and locked him up in the cottage & left for town. Ellina did not loose a second, she came out of her hiding place and dug the key out from where the men had buried it and unlocked the door & released Jhon. They both were delighted to see each other. They hugged & decided to rush to the nearby police station.

At the police station, on seeing Mr.Hinker the station officer, they felt very relieved. They narrated the entire incident to the police officer who listened with much interest. Mr Hinker realized that the kids have caught the thieves which the entire police force has been hunting for. He congratulated them on their bravery & went with a platoon of officers to arrest them. They easily managed to arrest the robbers as they were returning from another heist. And all the antiques were then returned to the museum.

The journalists from town came & covered the story how Ellina & John's bravery managed to capture the most wanted robbers. John & Ellina had become heroes of their town. Their parents were very happy to see them safe. Everyone in their school congratulated them and the town's Mayor also gave them an award for their bravery.
